properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): "no typed tool writes a TemporalFact" is OVERTURNED — record_finding writes a dated, measured TemporalFact with value and source on any node, a Decision included, and is served through the claude.ai flo2 connector. The agent never reached it because describe_schema, the tool it asked about the type, names no type's writer, while the type→writer map exists only in tools/vocabulary_reach.py. What HOLDS: nothing reads a measured value on a Constraint or Decision against the limit
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, triaging art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item I14 (second half).

① OBSERVED, from the designer's friction log: "No home for a dated measurement of a REFERENCE system. `basis: measured` exists only on a CONSTRAINS contribution … VERIFIES cannot target a Decision … the TemporalFact type may be meant for this, but no typed tool writes it." (#18). Then (#29): "describe_schema(node_type TemporalFact) was refused as reply_too_large (41,544 chars against a 30,000 limit). required_only showed one field. The real property set came from reading reflow2's own export locally. Each fact then took create_node plus create_edge HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT, with no typed tool." About 10 calls. What was measured was reflow2 0.74.0's cold open of its own design, as evidence for the new engine's cold-reload budget. Expected: a typed way to record a dated measured value with a unit and source, attached to the budget or decision it informs, as evidence and not as a verdict. NOT affected: a part's own measured spend (CONSTRAINS basis: measured, measured_at).

② PRECEDENT, searched in reflow2 and flo2: cap:a-quantity-carries-its-provenance-and-an-unsourced-one-is-named (realized: "a TemporalFact carries source"); dec:idea-a-measurement-that-refutes-the-designs-own-rule-has-nowhere-to-point (wish #39, a second project wanting a measurement to point at intent); fact:the-three-legs-audit-run-at-last-54-of-93-and-five-types-exist-only-in-the-schema. Nothing in flo2's design.

③ CANDIDATES, from the bones:
(a) SCHEMA/SURFACE — no typed writer for TemporalFact (the reporter's reading).
(b) DISCOVERABILITY — a writer exists and the agent's path to it was cut.
(c) READER — the record can be written, but no computation compares a measured observation with the budget it informs.
(d) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG — the connector serves a smaller surface without the writer.
(e) Not in the component suspected — the size refusal on describe_schema is flo2's reply limit, and I5 is triaged separately.

④ DISCRIMINATORS: (a) predicts no served tool writes TemporalFact with value, basis and source. (b) predicts one does, and that the path the agent took names none. (c) predicts budget_report ignores such a record. (d) predicts the connector's describe of the writer fails.

⑤ MEASURED on 0.74.0, isolated scratch store, plus the connector's own describe:
- record_finding{subject_id: dec:…, value: '{"value":1250,"unit":"ms"}', basis: measured, source, valid_from} WROTE a TemporalFact on a Decision. Its description says "a measurement taken". Through the claude.ai flo2 connector, `use_design_tool record_finding describe` returns it as served. ⇒ (a) and (d) REFUTED.
- find_tools with the designer's own words ("record a dated measured observation of a reference system with a value unit and source as evidence for a decision") ranks record_finding FIRST (score 19.4), and find_tools is served on the connector.
- describe_schema{node_type: TemporalFact}, with and without required_only, and the same for Requirement, Constraint and Verification: NONE of the replies names a typed tool that writes the type (grep for record_finding, add_* and "constructor": zero). The map exists in tools/vocabulary_reach.py:198 ("record_finding": "TemporalFact"), a repo script. Nothing served reads it. ⇒ (b) HOLDS. The agent asked the schema about the type it had learned from an export, and the schema could not say "record_finding writes this". The writer's name does not contain the type's name.
- budget_report on a Constraint carrying such a finding: contributors [] and verdict computed as before, with no mention of the finding. ⇒ (c) HOLDS. A measured observation of a REFERENCE system, e.g. "today's reflow2 opens its design in 1.25 s, so the new engine must load at least 2.1× faster", can be written but is never read beside the limit. `basis: measured` on CONSTRAINS would falsely claim it is the part's own spend.

⑥ CLASS: the three-legs shape again. The writer (tool leg) exists. The instruction leg is missing on the one read an agent reaches for about a TYPE. The mapping that would supply it is maintained in a script for a CI gate, not served. Would serving "written by: <tool>" on describe_schema's type reply have stopped the earlier sightings? It would have answered the 2026-09-19 case (a reporter who believed a flag missing) only in kind, not in instance, so it is claimed only for types.

⑦/⑧ OWED, NOT DONE: a pinning test that for every node type describe_schema names at least one served tool that writes it, reading the same map vocabulary_reach.py uses (fails today for all four types sampled); then the fix. Part (c) is an idea, not a defect, and is brainstormed as dec:idea-a-measured-observation-is-evidence-a-budget-or-decision-reads.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the designer tried find_tools (the log does not say). Also whether flo2's 30,000-char refusal of describe_schema happens before reflow2's own budget_chars trim, which is item I5.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #625 (squash 42259ba). describe_schema now answers `written_by` for every node type, and `drawn_by` for every edge, read from ONE map (crates/reflow2-mcp/writers.json) that tools/vocabulary_reach.py reads too. Its change record, chg:a-finding-or-refusal-names-the-route-that-works, is in the committed design, not this live store. Part (c), a reader beside the limit, stays with dec:idea-a-measured-observation-is-evidence-a-budget-or-decision-reads.
